top5.title: Microsoft launches a “Code Red” after a historic 24-hour outage
top5.description: Microsoft activated its highest alert level to review the handling of major incidents after an outage affected Exchange Online and several Microsoft 365 services. The company wants to resolve global incidents in under an hour, including with AI agents.
top5.why: Microsoft’s highest-level response to a major Microsoft 365 outage highlights the growing operational risks of cloud concentration and the push to use AI agents for faster incident recovery.

top5.title: European Union proposes a €50 billion AI fund
top5.description: The European Commission is proposing a €50 billion private-equity fund to take direct stakes in European AI and quantum-computing companies. The goal is to reduce the bloc’s dependence on American and Chinese technologies.
top5.why: The EU’s proposed €50 billion fund signals a major industrial-policy effort to build European AI and quantum champions and reduce dependence on U.S. and Chinese technology.

top5.title: Google warns of the arrival of autonomous AI cyberattacks
top5.description: Attackers are automating some stages of cyberattacks with AI agents. This development is increasing pressure on companies’ patching and incident-response processes.
top5.why: Google’s warning that attackers are automating parts of cyberattacks with AI raises the urgency of patching, detection and incident-response capabilities across every enterprise.

top5.title: Amazon acquires Decart to narrow the software gap with Nvidia
top5.description: Amazon is acquiring Decart’s team and optimization technologies. The deal could improve Trainium performance and give AWS customers more alternatives to Nvidia GPUs.
top5.why: Amazon’s acquisition of Decart could improve the performance of its Trainium chips, strengthening AWS’s effort to reduce customer dependence on Nvidia GPUs.

top5.title: The Business-to-Agent economy is becoming a market that is hard to ignore
top5.description: According to Andreessen Horowitz, agents are becoming primary visitors to the Internet and increasingly influencing online spending. Shopify is seeing a sharp rise in AI-driven traffic and orders, while retailers are divided between blocking and welcoming agents.
top5.why: The rise of AI agents as web visitors and purchasing intermediaries could reshape online discovery, retail traffic and the rules companies use to decide whether to welcome or block automated access.
